products.description: The Porodo Lifestyle Chillo Mista combines a handheld fan with a fine cooling mist for extra relief on hot days. A 2000mAh battery gives up to 13.5 hours of fan runtime, while the 30ml see-through water tank produces 1.6-4.5 hours of misting depending on setting. Five airflow speeds (up to 6.3 m/s) from a brushless motor keep operation quiet at 45-62dB, and the white ABS housing recharges via USB-C in about 3.5 hours.
products.metaDescription: The Porodo Lifestyle Chillo Mista combines a handheld fan with a fine cooling mist for extra relief on hot days.

products.title: Porodo Smart AI Voice Control Fan with 5200mAh Battery & Mist Function - Black
products.subtitle: 5200mAh · 25ml
products.description: The Porodo Lifestyle Chillo Bot is a smart handheld fan with AI voice control, letting you switch modes and speeds hands-free. It packs a 5200mAh (19.24Wh) battery for up to 11 hours of use, a 10,000 RPM brushless motor with 1-200 adjustable speed levels, and both ice-cooling and fine-mist cooling modes fed by a 25ml water tank. A TFT display shows battery and charging status, and the ABS-and-metal body includes a mountaineering-buckle clip for hands-free carrying.
products.metaDescription: The Porodo Lifestyle Chillo Bot is a smart handheld fan with AI voice control, letting you switch modes and speeds hands-free.

products.title: Porodo Lifestyle Chillo Plus Portable Fan, Retractable Cable & 6000mAh Power Bank - White
products.subtitle: 6000mAh · 8m
products.description: The Porodo Lifestyle Chillo Plus is a 2-in-1 handheld cooling fan and 6000mAh power bank in one rugged ABS, PC, stainless steel and aluminum-alloy body. It runs up to 21 hours on standard fan mode or 4.4 hours in ice-cooling mode, spinning 6,880-10,600 RPM for 5-8 m/s airflow, and recharges in about 3.5 hours via its built-in retractable USB-C cable. A lanyard attachment and power-bank output let it double as an emergency charger for your phone on the move.
products.metaDescription: The Porodo Lifestyle Chillo Plus is a 2-in-1 handheld cooling fan and 6000mAh power bank in one rugged ABS, PC, stainless steel and aluminum-alloy body.

products.title: Porodo PowerBeam 5000mAh Powerbank with Flashlight - Khaki
products.subtitle: 12W · 5000mAh
products.description: The Porodo PowerBeam is a rugged 5000mAh power bank built for outdoor use, combining a built-in flashlight with an integrated carabiner hook for easy clipping to a bag or belt. USB-C input/output at 5V/2.4A (up to 12W) charges devices quickly and recharges the bank itself in about 110 minutes, while the compact khaki-toned shell and battery-level indicator make it a practical companion for camping, hiking, and travel.
products.metaDescription: The Porodo PowerBeam is a rugged 5000mAh power bank built for outdoor use, combining a built-in flashlight with an integrated carabiner hook for easy clipping to a bag or belt.

products.title: Porodo 10000mAh Powerbank 2xType-C/USB-A, Digital Display, Integrated Cable - Black
products.subtitle: 20W · 10000mAh
products.description: This Porodo 10000mAh (37Wh) power bank pairs a built-in integrated Lightning cable with USB-C (up to 20W output, 18W input) and USB-A (up to 22.5W) ports for flexible multi-device charging, plus a digital display for real-time battery monitoring. Fast-charging support takes it from 0-60% in about 35 minutes, and the compact black housing needs no separate cables for on-the-go top-ups.

products.title: Porodo 10000mAh Power Bank 5V/3A(Max) TFT Display - Dark Grey
products.subtitle: 20W · 10000mAh

products.title: Porodo Slimmag 10000mAh TFT Display Slim Magnetic Wireless Powerbank - Grey
products.subtitle: 20W · 10000mAh

products.metaDescription: The Porodo SlimMag is a slim, pocket-sized 10000mAh magnetic power bank with an aluminum-alloy shell and N54 MagSafe-compatible magnets for a strong, secure attachment to compatible phones.

products.title: Porodo Piano 30000mAh Power Bank with 4-Wire Plugin & Hanging Rope - Black
products.subtitle: 30000mAh

products.metaDescription: The Porodo Piano 30000mAh power bank is a high-capacity (111Wh) charger with built-in Micro-USB, USB-C, and Lightning cables, so you can charge almost any device without hunting for a separate cord.

products.title: Porodo Lifestyle Wave White Noise Bluetooth Speaker 1500mAh - White

products.title: Porodo Soundtec Snapp Vibe RGB Wireless Magnetic Speaker - Blue
products.subtitle: 500mAh · Bluetooth 5.4 · IPX6
